meaning: Gain of the PID controller: how strongly its output reacts to the gap between setpoint and measured value. A non-linear controller takes one value per ERROR entry.
Derivative time of the PID controller: how strongly it reacts to how fast the measured value changes. A non-linear controller takes one value per ERROR entry.
Integral time of the PID controller. The longer the time, the more slowly the controller corrects a lasting gap.
On a SOURCE: how much mass enters per second, all phases together. Give a list to change it over time.
The target the controller steers its measured value toward, in the unit of that measured value. A list when it changes over time (paired with TIME).
